notes.title: Beast Hour. №27. October 2023. Fiend
notes.notes:
[b]Raiders and Beasts![/b]

The end of fall is the scariest night of the year! This day ghosts, werewolves, vampires and other horrible creatures wake up and go hunting. And now, after a long sleep, a creature of darkness awakens, and its name is Fiend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/a1a30dbc22fa73ca9aecda13471f8acabb1e85c3.jpg[/img]

Fiend is just gaining strength and has not yet reached the world of Beast Hour. But our team has already collected data on the appearance and behavior of this dark Beast.

[b]Mirror, mirror on the wall…[/b]

Hearing the word "Fiend" each person imagines a different thing: from small tricksters, to great servants of darkness. But what, usually, all such creatures have in common? These are horns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/7140daa161572367646462febecaf65e953ec6c8.jpg[/img]

Horns demonstrate power and create an intimidating appearance, as well as symbolize cruelty and ruthlessness. In some mythologies, horned demons are considered to be holders of hidden knowledge and supernatural wisdom. And some believe that the horns serve as keys that open gates to other worlds or dimensions.

In case of our team, we again decided to draw inspiration from the game “Prince of Persia: Warrior Within” remembering the time demon Dahaka’s horns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/11fc1c4d535e8a9fb0cec5c3319c53e420f4f83f.jpg[/img]

Researching the concept, we tried different character attributes design variations. But we always kept in mind the main thing – just a sight of such a creature should make blood run cold in your veins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/c16588a0bd01c1eb7a78dc35669860cb0e3cdff3.jpg[/img]

[b]Behavior and temper[/b]

Fiend is very agile and can climb walls like Werewolf. Do its hooves make trouble? Well, they help the mountain goats a lot…

Fiend is an otherworld creature, which limits are not yet fully understood. What is already clear, is that our Fiend's single and terrifying eye is not just for beauty and intimidation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/afe3aaecd9d21f8bcabc029d7f27b8205f75f9e5.jpg[/img]

[b]Result[/b]

While Fiend has not yet entered the world of Beast Hour, Raiders, Werewolves, and Vampires have a bit more time to "rest".

notes.title: Beast Hour. №24. July 2023. Beasts visual
notes.notes:
Raiders and Beasts!

We've already told how Raiders were created and what concept was used for them, so today it's the Beasts' turn.

Beast Hour wasn't originally planned as the game with unique characters: all Raiders were knights in armor, and the Beast was only the Werewolf. Hence the name of the game is Beast Hour, which means 'Werewolf Hour'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/54e2979a048c2db002f1afb77392491ff3aae693.jpg[/img]

But when we decided that Raiders needed to be diverse, so we did the same for the others. In fact, Werewolves are one of the most mainstream characters in the mass culture, ahead of them are only zombies, but they didn't fit the concept of our game. By the way, there aren't really that many games that allow you to play as a Werewolf, although a lot of movies/books/series feature these creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/6bd86294f16ce3c4f3e8a1f7abaf9115cbb37ad2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/eaaea08245166cb54461ac13a8e2b5e3aeae0c56.jpg[/img]
[i]The early Werewolf concepts[/i]

We approached the creation of the werewolf with great care, we didn't want to make it too human, for example, as in "The Wolf Among Us", so the references were reptiles first, and then - apes with their specific running, when the weight comes on the front arms phalanges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/f0eba46c90c79472ca4781100f0afaffd252aea1.jpg[/img]

It was also simple to choose the next character: werewolves, and then vampires. Bram Stoker's "Dracula", Friedrich Murnau's "Nosferatu: Symphony of Terror", Neil Jordan's "Interview with the Vampire", and of course Troika Games' "Vampire the Masquerade". You can probably easily complete this list yourself with books, movies or games that have featured Vampires in many different incarnations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/7c27de3a469da981cc9d6642176bc90799c81ded.png[/img]

Again, we weren't satisfied with the mainstream "pale man with fangs" image, so the Vampire in Beast Hour looks more like a bat. We used the movies "Underworld" and "Van Helsing" as references.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/87fa8db0d2f7a13fd47605cab01c25bbd1536d50.jpg[/img]

[b]Conclusion[/b]

Thanks for reading till the end! It's interesting that these creatures can look completely different. Which Beast do you think will appear in the game next? Guess in the comments!

notes.title: Beast Hour. №23. Июнь 2023. Матч мейкинг
notes.notes:
Raiders and Beasts!

Today, we will explain the reason behind having 8 players in the game session.

The game was initially planned for 10 players: 8 Raiders and 2 Beasts (we've already [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250/view/3684547928689627496]told[/url] about the first idea of the game). We've planned an unusual 'team vs team' mode, where the Beasts would compete with each other for the Raiders, and the latter could play both individually and in groups. In fact, this concept is similar to Dead by Daylight, but with more players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/778dcef3da2db5f97c0b3c3549fa8dec6cba235b.jpg[/img]

[b]Team vs Team[/b]

Then we decided to try a team variant of 5 Raiders vs 5 Beasts. We took inspiration from Nosgoth, a game with 8 players in one match (4 for each side), for this concept.

The experiment turned the game into a complete deathmatch: players began to run in groups, parkour took a back seat, and the large map became less meaningful for chases. Also, unlike Nosgoth, Beast Hour has no class divisions (like Tank, Support, and DD), which ultimately led us to abandon the 'team vs team' PvP approach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2227bef8b456108afe66a5818f01cf72b9a11df6.gif[/img]

Then the number of players has been reduced to 7: 5 Raiders and 2 Beasts (tests showed that having 1 monster is too boring). To diversify the gameplay, additional activity points have appeared on the already updated map: Arkana quests, escape mechanics, and altars for Beasts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/5cbd2a3cfaab75eaa9a12e7207fba5b6e970cf03.jpg[/img]

[b]Arkana Storm and equal number of players[/b]

The ratio of 5 to 2 was interesting, but not ideal. 2 Beasts could only chase 2 Raiders. Even then, we've decided that Beast Hour would be a game without allies, which meant that 2 more Raiders could fight each other. That left one player, who basically shouldn't be afraid of an attack. So the solution came by itself: we added one more Beast and each player had an opponent.

But a new problem arose: due to the transition to the mechanics of respawns with their cancellation in the game's second phase, the last two or three players were hard to find each other in the final phase of the game on a large map for 8 participants. And that's where the idea of battle royale - space limitations, and the idea of not only narrowing the zone, but also moving it around the map - came to the rescue. This immediately solved the problem with the last players in the match and added variety.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/93cc341aa534eb2491b0ea7e266e61908724506f.gif[/img]

So we've got a clear scheme for the game:
[list]
[*] there are 8 players in the match (5 Raiders and 3 Beasts),
[*] in the first phase everyone respawns, regardless of the character type,
[*] in the second phase, players can no longer respawn (only the Raiders have one try at the beginning),
[*] zone narrows and shifts, maximizing the drama of the finale.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/573b0569cd825b619e97c9f28527d603ae2d057a.jpg[/img]

[b]Conclusion[/b]

Thanks for reading till the end! From time to time we try to change the number of players per match, but the current tests show that right now 5 vs 3 is the best ratio. This may change. What do you think would be the right number of players for Beast Hour? Share your opinion in the comments!

notes.title: Beast Hour. №22. May 2023. Characters customization
notes.notes:
Raiders and Beasts!

Today we'd like to talk about characters' skins – the feature we started working on not so long ago.

That's quite a frequent question on our social media, if we're planning to add customization in the game. And the answer is always - yes!

All multiplayer games have skins, which devs regularly add into the game. That brings more variety and personality, because you can not only play as your favorite character, but also change his or her appearance as you like.

For quite a time our artists have been designing different skins, that would fit perfectly into the overall atmosphere of the game. This includes radical re-coloring of the standard look, as well as new appearance that completely transforms the character. From time to time we share such arts on our social media. However, we started to implement the customization system in the game itself just recently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/b5d8e48bec10a292d1832157f596541f4d7839bd.jpg[/img]
[i]Standard re-color[/i]

[b]Raiders[/b]

It wasn't hard to come up with skins for Raiders: since they are humans in suits, we just have divided their outfits on 3 customizable parts – head, arms and body. That allows players to mix and match them, creating unique looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ee3f6cd165e4f1689661e476575227d69f70df37.jpg[/img]
[i]Combination of different sets[/i]

[b]Beasts[/b]

But we've faced some obstacles with Beasts. As they are naked monsters we can't split customization into 3 parts as we did for Raiders. Otherwise they would have visible "seams". Still we needed 3 customization parts, so we decided to change the following:

1. [b]body type[/b] - the whole "naked" body and its coloring, what solves the problem of seams between the parts;

2. [b]suit[/b] - different variations in clothing and decorations below the head/neck;

3. [b]head[/b] - things for the head/neck, like extra "hats", "collars" etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/748e403865b2a52b6504c03cc1887f690434fb44.jpg[/img]
[i]Various combinations for Beasts[/i]

[b]First prototypes[/b]

We already have a fair number of sketches that could be put to work and added to the game. But for the sake of time saving and testing the whole system (and, if necessary, tweak the images at the idea stage), we first added a set of the simplest "stubs".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/b02f06be1fd1c88eddbf35720c830cb9b284bf50.jpg[/img]
[i]Skins prototypes[/i]

This is why most of the "skins" in the game now are very bright and colourful. It's no coincidence that we chose such a toxic palette - it makes it easier to find bugs and gives more insight into the system work.

[b]Conclusion[/b]

Thank you for reading till the end. Which concept do you like best? Share your opinion in the comments!

notes.title: Beast Hour. №21. April 2023. Raider's visual
notes.notes:
Raiders and Beasts!

Gameplay and concept art usually come alongside. Cases when developers think of their game as "gray boxes" are pretty rare, since the story and characters one wants to play spontaneously appear in the mind.

[b]Parkour knights[/b]

The very first idea for Beast Hour was a gothic castle, where knights should run away from beasts. So we chose medieval setting and put armor on all Raiders. Since from the beginning parkour was the key idea for the game, we quickly dropped the idea about knights as it would be impossible to run fast and deftly in heavy armor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ff76c402e5ef3b6d09d1d3ed961ca8e6f26cf8dc.jpg[/img]

So a new Raider concept, which can be described as the mix of medieval age and steampunk, appeared. This visual was simplified, we left only greaves, helmet, and bracers. But even this seemed to be too much. Plus there was a problem with the weapon - what a knight without a sword - it wasn't clear what it should be and how the character would run with it during the parkour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/57788f2c95fe6e533ce609aa5ce128abcc597285.jpg[/img]

[b]Steampunk ninja-wizards[/b]

We started experimenting a lot, trying to create something unique and averaged between ninjas, Dishonored characters and steampunk. After a while we've finally chosen the time epoch - World War I and the Industrial Revolution - and the Raiders became wizards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/68ee9b789bfe9d64f87b27406510566635651216.jpg[/img]

So, the character wore a high collar cape (Doctor Strange-like), but we've noticed that Raider didn't look like a fighter and wasn't brutal enough.

notes.title: Beast Hour. №20. March 2023. Gamedesign
notes.notes:
Raiders & Beasts!

Today we'd like to take a look at the genre of asymmetric PvP games and share our experience of developing Beast Hour.

[b]All new – well forgotten old[/b]

This genre exists for a long time and a lot of games have been released. When Beast Hour development started, we tried to find as much information about the first asymmetric games as possible. Then Giants: Citizen Kabuto, released in 2000 by Planet Moon Studios, caught our eye. This game is quite unique, as there are three races involved in a single match: 5 Sea Ripers, 3 Meccaryn and 1 giant Kabuto.

Analyzing other games is necessary for understanding the genre and a great source of inspiration for development. That's why we tried to study everything that could be useful in any way, mostly such games as Dead by Daylight, Evolve, Last Year, Predator: Hunting Grounds, Deathgarden.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/c9c21e0761484b1a1484e3f51e88598b2071f3b3.jpg[/img]

[b]Not a DbD-clone[/b]

Of course, the main idea of "ones run away - others catch them" for us was Dead by Daylight, released in 2016 by Behavior Studios. It was one of the first internal projects independently created and published by this studio. The game quickly gained an audience and now it's considered the most popular asymmetrical horror game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ca2bae15267851a03eab79d3506a43b9c8199b39.jpg[/img]
[i]If Entity took Zelus into Dead by Daylight world, who would win?[/i]

It gave us a lot of ideas as we realized that players really like such games. But we didn't want to make another "DbD-clone". So, to the formula "1 immortal player against the opposing team" we've also added parkour elements and vertical gameplay. Thus, the first version of Beast Hour appeared. The game was: out of ten human Raiders random two turn into Beasts and hunt the remaining eight, trying to turn them into their pack's monsters.

Admittedly, it's problematic to find a perfect balance in games of this genre. An immortal boss-player is much stronger than any team member one-on-one, but a well-cooperated group drastically changes the balance in its favor. Plus, we didn't really like the idea of Beasts, one can do nothing against.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/d35676b870d7ac8f7c962a481605e9da256e73fc.gif[/img]

[b]Main ideas[/b]

By trial and error approach, we came up with three main principles, on which Beast Hour development is based even today:

1. [b]No allies game. [/b]Playing in teams, players would run together and enter team fights, so the whole point of parkour chases was lost. We wanted to focus on the dynamics of the game, which was only possible without teammates.

2. [b]The option to fight back. [/b]Since now there are no allies, we gave the opportunity to freely choose the role and fight any player, whether it's Beast or Raider. By the way, the players who have previously tried Dead by Daylight, like this idea a lot. Survivors often say that they would like to have more opportunities to "mock" the killer.

3. [b]Several bosses. [/b]The game involves three "bosses" at once, competing with each other for prey. It helps not only reinforce the ideas above, but also to create more "Beast after Raider" chases. It makes situations impossible where Raiders start to unintentionally team up against one Beast. Also the fights between monsters give a Raider more chances to survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/0412cda8b3d85108506095fc22cabef3c23211e8.gif[/img]

On the whole, these principles gave the project its most important feature: the unique game experience of each match. Players decide whether to help or run, fight or flee, rely on cunning + agility or combat skills. This is what makes Beast Hour the game you want to play again and again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ba935a330290311342c0ef83cb3c3f7ebbdc05d2.gif[/img]

[b]Conclusion[/b]

Thanks for reading this article. We wanted to share our experience with asymmetric PvP development and perhaps answer some questions about Beast Hour genre. Share your opinion in the comments!

Make sure to check our regular livestreams at [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH8SHBl_9bXEuNOr2ddveMQ]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/beasthourgame]Twitch[/url] channels, since it's a great opportunity for us to talk with you!

notes.notes:
Raiders and Beasts!

It’s time to melt cold Winter days with the flame of our new character – Drake!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/a23761223a402b2c4b6836043a36d83beda85866.gif[/img]

[b]Short backstory[/b]

In the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250/view/3379415101024643316]article[/url] about Vampire, we’ve talked about how we came to the decision to make each character unique. Still we left something unmentioned: for each Raider we’ve chosen the element. Electricity coupled perfectly with the steampunk and fitted to the lore of our first Raider. That’s how Zelus, a scientist of the Industrial Revolution, was created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/1c99eec895e96719e6e8d50b7db91dc110fdb747.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/08d9a76166d2aee4c20d8e97d59b86158b008244.jpg[/img]

[b]Drake concept[/b]

After we’ve created two characters, we started to think what element should be chosen for the next character. The answer didn’t take long – fire! So, we started creating some concepts for Drake in the style of steampunk and even dieselpunk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/f0e18769f75d19a81e97098a41f115070cde4777.jpg[/img]

Then we’ve decided to make the design closer to the era of the first half of the XX century. The main reference for this was The Rocketeer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ff98d0994db6ee38769e6edd4e6d1495c432d0b6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/74246a0a2c5184443262384f66d5a4e52dea388f.jpg[/img]

Drake’s design was good, but the eye sockets of his helmet were too similar with the Zelus’ glasses, so we’ve changed Drake a little.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2a705df8b2b7edeebc70a912323fadd479b8cf47.jpg[/img] 

[b]Abilities[/b]

Since we were creating Vampire along with Drake, we’ve decided to add him a jetpack, as a sort of “reaction” to Vampire’s gliding.

notes.title: Beast Hour. № 17. December 2022. Summary of the year
notes.notes:
Raiders & Beasts!

Another year of Beast Hour development is behind. In today's newsletter we'll recall some of the coolest and the most memorable things that have happened this year as well as share our future hero plans!

[b]News and streams[/b]

It was at the beginning of 2022 when we got an idea to regularly post news about Beast Hour in this format. We published the summary of 2021 and so it started – there was not a single month we missed and each time we shared something exciting about the game both on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563250/Beast_Hour/]Steam[/url] and via [url=https://mailganer.com/landing/55677/]emails[/url]. Not only do we not plan to stop doing so, but we want to make these newsletters even better and more informative. Share your suggestions for new formats and topics in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/6a6177524420a6a316412bdd52e8d46870de2af4.jpg[/img]

By the way, alongside the newsletters, at the beginning of 2022 we also started making Beast Hour Q&A-streams, so that you have a direct way of communicating with us. We are a very open team thus we've decided to give EVERYONE an opportunity to take part in those streams. The only thing you need to do is join our [url=http://discord.gg/5KFaakTP24]Discord[/url] server and its voice chat – and you're live with us! Come and participate in the upcoming Q&A-stream at the 13th of January 2023.

[previewyoutube=w4AmiEaAPf4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]January 2022[/b]

In the first month of the year we did a lot of cool stuff. The biggest accomplishment was the new UI which replaced an old and technical one. If you've been following Beast Hour long enough you probably remember that first game videos and gifs didn't have any UI at all. Not because we didn't have any, but because we didn't want to show an obviously unfinished aspect of the project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/e4fcad3b1f42c526d4b3e86e408a1da1f77292f6.jpg[/img]

On top of all of that, that was the month our fan wrote a Beast Hour [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TDM1R_ayvGM]rap song[/url] and we made a small clip out of it. You should check it out!

[b]February 2022[/b]

In February the Spider district got updated and became an even more frightening and atmospheric place. Since then we kept on adding new pathways, mechanics and secrets to uncover – definitely visit it when you play Beast Hour next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/dd0df7a87dc82eed59b92247ff2dea106ddc2b66.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/aedde350c7c027e9822fa382589ea23bd5d16918.jpg[/img]

[b]March 2022[/b]

You asked us a lot and we heard you: in March we started developing a new hero – Vampire! The character was on a very early stage and so we could only show the first concept art. But, as it turned out, it was enough as we received a lot of positive feedback – thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/c05dbc29e575a4731c5b5358966dd487cc8f6146.jpg[/img]

[b]April 2022[/b]

During the whole development cycle Beast Hour supported only two languages: English and Russian. But we knew that wasn't enough – we wanted to be sure that players from all over the world would have a chance to play the game. At this point we started looking for fans who could help with localizations. The first language was Japanese (it was unexpected even for us!)

Now there are multiple translations in the work: Spanish, French, Chinese, German, Polish and Arabic. If you know Italian, Korean or Portuguese – we'd be happy to see you in our team! Just send us an email at info@beasthour.com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/1416479004d702bb17dfa168179db111d02bdd4c.jpg[/img]

[b]May 2022[/b]

In May we decided to tell more about Ziplines – one of our escape mechanics. Using Ziplines Raiders can go down from high buildings to keep the distance from pursuing Beasts. During the year we also showed you:

- [b]Cracked walls[/b] to roll under and stop the chaser.
- [b]Ropes [/b]to go up on rooftops quickly.
- [b]Portals [/b]to teleport to a random spot on the map.
- [b]Bridges [/b]to move between high rooftops.
- [b]Vault objects[/b] to jump over and get a speed boost.

During the next Beast Hour test you'll be able to experience them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/67736a025d8531b1bd8d444e84988fb24d5bee89.gif[/img]

[b]June 2022[/b]

It was one of the most important months in Beast Hour history! At 19th of June we ran our first ever public testing with the fans. It's hard to describe the feeling – a mixture of excitement and anxiety that made it into the most memorable day of the year for our team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/66e749db9fbb08d30f04e7442d61481ecaa2e2ad.jpg[/img]

[b]July 2022[/b]

Nikitozzz drew the first Beast Hour fan comic! It's so great when your efforts inspire other people – for that alone it's worth developing games! In the following months Nikitozzz continued to make more artwork, some of which will soon be published in our social media channels – [url=http://linktr.ee/BeastHour]subscribe[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/97b7e0ebedd4ff1cff8e3f67b96d3c929af0ff2a.jpg[/img]

[b]August 2022[/b]

After a few tests in a row it was decided to focus on solving the main issues the game had, including match connection problems and balancing. But it didn't mean we stopped making more features – on the contrary! In August we announced a number of them, and the most important one became the action log. It allows you to see the exact number of experience you get from every activity as well as informing you of events and the like. We also implemented sound settings, bridges and parkour improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/34ff203aca7d56cab80353cc2b10727d911a596d.jpg[/img]

[b]September 2022[/b]

In September we continued – nicknames were added, freezes at the start of every match were fixed and general map enhancements were done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/179ed619a8ca225088b6b6e3ec0e522ec0f538a4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/6f38825a9ce0912e1795035b0da50d31d216b5d2.jpg[/img]

[b]October 2022[/b]

It's a fact that thanks to Halloween many call October the spookiest month! We decided to celebrate this day by showcasing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250?emclan=103582791469900204&emgid=3379415101024643316]Vampire[/url] in all its glory! It turned out to be a great article which is useful to other developers, lore enthusiasts and hardcore gamers who wish to know everything about heroes to get an advantage on the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/5e1a91f16ccab8e85b42903e6373490a0da758c8.gif[/img]

[b]November 2022[/b]

This gloomy autumn month we dedicated to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250?emclan=103582791469900204&emgid=3645130650404661274]the map of Beast Hour and its history[/url]. This was the first 100% lore newsletter. Read it if you want to get acquainted with the city and not to get lost in there next time playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/c5cabb6d79a0dd1698c02de45319f1efeb770ee0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2ed1b95fb8ec6adeb6d6fd3d3dca4f461fdb9299.jpg[/img]

[b]December 2022[/b]

And lastly, a few weeks ago during one of our internal playtests we played Beast Hour with the controller. After many matches we figured out the best layout for our team. What do you think of it and would you use it yourself?

[b]New Raider – Drake![/b]

The most attentive of our fans remember that a year ago, in the summary of 2021, we hinted a new character but during the following months never mentioned him again. That's about to change! In one of the next newsletters he will be the center of our attention. Stay tuned!

One of the earliest concept arts of Drake:

notes.title: Beast Hour. №16. Map development and backstory
notes.notes:
Raiders & Beasts!

In today’s newsletter we’d love to share with you the haunted city development plans as well as the backstory of this scary place. 

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE[/b]: The following screenshots have been taken from a development build of Beast Hour and some of the map enhancements are not yet ready! Follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/BeastHour]social media[/url] to see how the game evolves and changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/23058a8a36e19cdbf25c72a111643ebf01d7fb6b.jpg[/img]

Haunted city is divided into five districts: garden, burning, industrial, spider and city center. Let’s talk about each of them individually.

[b]The Garden district[/b]

It got its name thanks to lavish greenery – this is the only place in the haunted city where you can find living trees and blooming flowers. It’s situated right at the foot of a high mountain. A good place to start our trip because the main source of Arkana, the most precious resource of Beast Hour universe, was originally extracted from under this very mountain. An extensive network of railroad tracks stretches across the whole district. It was built to transport Arkana to other parts of the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/55c6e920d90e0ad1e5f1818eced71df0946edbf9.jpg[/img]

Under the Garden district you can also find underground tombs of ancient kings and queens illuminated by glowing mushrooms unique to this biome. These tombs form convenient pathways for both Raiders and Beasts to travel across the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/441caca52f15278f43d5ffebea3527b63aeff3be.jpg[/img]

An old wooden mill with ever spinning wind blades is another landmark of this area. No one knows for sure why even on the most quiet days these blades are always moving but it’s just one of many anomalies of this city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/70a2629b403eacef131e71d734776608295004b9.gif[/img]

The symbol of this place is the Bowl of Hygieia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/1768f9500167dcef1b6a795e3e23f5637d24821c.jpg[/img]

[b]The Burning district[/b]

If the Garden is full of life (however strange it might be), the Burning district is the opposite. This is where most of Arkana was transported to and, probably, processed in. Due to a strange phenomenon this part of the city is constantly on fire which makes it impossible for any lifeforms to grow and survive. It’s not recommended to stay here for long as the strong burning smell and large amounts of carbon dioxide make it harder to breathe and explore. Not to mention the heat which is almost unbearable for any living creature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/88ff805012567ec017e92b238beddbd2e369f3ed.jpg[/img]

Above this hellish landscape there is a huge zeppelin with a number of smaller balloons flying nearby. Some say they were used for Arkana processing purposes. Others claim they flew far away and landed after the city had been abandoned. In any case, nowadays the zeppelin and the balloons remain quiet watchers of Burning district. A skilled explorer can climb all the way up using ropes between balloons to get a great view of the place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/fdcea5e9ba4a21c29e011e92c0bd0c761c0f709b.jpg[/img]

The symbol of this place is Cerberus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ec5f1186ec8977bc00fc6330ca6077e9a46e8ac1.jpg[/img]

[b]The Industrial district[/b]

This was the heart of the haunted city’s technology development. Thanks to Arkana, local scientists made groundbreaking inventions and produced marvelous machinery that were centuries ahead of their time! The smoke from furnaces, the noise from plant equipment, the smell of molten metal – all of that were an indispensable part of the Industrial district. When the city was forgotten, the engines stopped and the sky became clear of the smoke once again. After hundreds of years the most adventurous Raiders are still finding new pieces of tech unseen anywhere else. Good place for raiding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/a16eea30c5bf88e0815ef3394645449958e276a7.jpg[/img]

If you are brave enough, you may go below the ground level and explore an arena where both Cult and Order experimented on Werewolves and their evolution. Here’s where a lot of blood was spilled and where some of the most cruel fights between Beasts took place. This is not for the faint-hearted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/4af63fe3b093234df8b5dc3b620da72fabee207a.jpg[/img]

The symbol of this place is Gargoyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/e2da8b2fc97ff52c57eebc9c5fde90cf25e8bc0e.jpg[/img]

[b]The Spider district[/b]

Despite the name, spiders were not the original inhabitants of this area. On the contrary, it was the most respectable and secure place where rich and powerful people used to live. But now it is the district even courageous Raiders try to avoid unless it’s absolutely necessary to go in there. The place is swarming with spiders, webs and hidden pitfalls, so watch out your every step here or you might end up caught by a giant spider in the catacombs where nobody will ever find you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/481a475c25d28c4c4b3126386bae8144dc4061a5.jpg[/img]

On top of it all, there are remains of the Spider Queen that even Werewolves and Vampires are afraid of! Be especially careful while exploring this part of the city!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/d958d6ebbe14ae109292f5727f907d902baf7d1b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/f9c778f98de3f794f573117f5a76a1ce5238f3e0.jpg[/img]

The symbol of this place is the Reaper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/292f5adf73c670e210db0f3b6e443076786e1f6e.jpg[/img]

[b]The City center[/b]

Probably the most well-preserved district of them all. Here you can find an abundance of statues, squares and a few narrow streets. It was the place of craftsmen, blacksmiths and shopkeepers. But this also was a place for executions where crowds of citizens gathered every day to watch this gruesome act of violence. Yet, its last victim is still alive and keeping the city safe from most of the intruders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/8b91bcfde9972cbff6b38716fab29651c945378a.jpg[/img]

The grand Temple is located in the very center of the map. It’s the biggest and the highest building around. If you manage to climb to the very top, you can easily see the entirety of the city. Beneath the Temple there is a hidden library and a whole network of underground ways leading to every district. 

The City center is where the city lived and thrived, but also where it died and was forgotten for many generations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/fbd50b0ff2f458842269ba60f5ca16498fd80f25.jpg[/img]

[b]Conclusion[/b]

We hope you've enjoyed our small trip to the haunted city. If you like to see the place for yourself, please, wishlist Beast Hour on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563250/Beast_Hour/]Steam[/url] and participate in future [url=https://mailganer.com/landing/55677/]Alpha tests[/url]!

Make sure to check our livestreams we regularly have at our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH8SHBl_9bXEuNOr2ddveMQ]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/beasthourgame]Twitch[/url] channels for almost an entire year by now. The next stream will take place in the middle of December, and the [url=https://youtu.be/43kosM_wvuA]latest one[/url] you can find on Youtube.

Follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/BeastHour]social media[/url] platforms and support on [url=https://www.patreon.com/beasthour]Patreon[/url] – it does help our small indie team to bring Beast Hour to a next level!

notes.title: Beast Hour. №15. October 2022. Vampire!
notes.notes:
Raiders & Beasts!

Today's newsletter is going to be a special one. It's Halloween time – the night of pumpkins and glowing eyes, of bats and spooky stories! It's time to tell you more about the Vampire – our new Beast in the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/c05dbc29e575a4731c5b5358966dd487cc8f6146.jpg[/img]

It's important to mention that the Vampire is still in development. Do not expect this Beast to be added in the next public Alpha-test. Nevertheless, we've already put so much work into this character, so we've got A LOT to share with you!

[b]Where did it all begin?[/b]

it’s necessary to start from the beginning. The original idea of Beast Hour could be described like: "knights run away from werewolves in a gothic castle". As one of our very first gameplay prototype testers noticed back then: "the game is like Super Mario with multiplayer & Werewolves – all you can do is run, jump and collect coins".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/8b679cd835dd4ba10e1d7c2e41e45cc5336b5bec.gif[/img]

Game rules were very simple – in the beginning of the match two random players out of ten became Werewolves. The remaining human players (it was before we came up with the name "Raiders") had to find, collect and bring spheres to activate portals. Once a player collected enough, he/she would be able to escape & win the game. Werewolves had to hunt down Raiders to turn them into monsters! With each minute the number of Raiders was decreasing and the number of Beasts – increasing! As a Raider you didn't have a chance to slack off because even the most skilled player couldn't stand against a pack of Werewolves.

Initially, we were not going to make each Raider unique. On the contrary, the plan was to have a blank slate to customize as much as possible. Only selected few pieces of armour could impact the hero's abilities. Yet, the following series of tests proved that our audience was not interested in this approach, and, truth be told, neither were we.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/8c428c8b97276ab518b999eeb26c79ab5ff89bbd.gif[/img]

We decided to go with individual personalities and gameplay styles. Many players enjoyed playing as Werewolves – not many games bring them to the fore – we also realized that we needed more Beasts diversity too. 

[b]Why the Vampire?[/b]

We asked a bunch of people: "What other Beasts would you like to see in Beast Hour?" The answers varied, but the most common one was evident – Vampires! That's really not surprising, as vampires are very popular in modern games and movies. Plus, they are ideal for our game's setting! On top of that, we wanted to make something completely different from Werewolf gameplay – we wanted to make a flying Beast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/cccfff2579d8747e4652a5dab6d4613639e786ff.jpg[/img]

It was obvious that our Vampire should not only be easily recognizable, but also unique and memorable. We intentionally did not use the image of a "vampire aristocrat" – it would have gone against our vision. The character should be "the terror that flaps in the night".

We started to work on first sketches (yes, they were made on copy papers with a pencil):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/b1b24384700e3321d6a9b3cd070ea2bfa7e900cc.jpg[/img]

Our sources of inspiration came from games and movies first of all. We were especially interested in characters from the "Van Helsing", "Underworld" and "Batman" movies. Talking about games, the greatest influence came from "Nosgoth", “Castlevania” and “Order 1886”. That's how we made reference boards like this one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/64a6d7f7e3ba4802b4b61efabb1fc38edafbd08a.jpg[/img]

Typically, Vampires are portrayed like dark angels with human hands and webbed wings behind their back. But notice the fact that bat's wings are also their hands, which is a very unusual concept for Vampires in pop culture. So, this was the approach we used for our character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/42d8fd79cdbe72ecefba1b6fd0316b8c99b93f45.jpg[/img]

[b]How do you play it?[/b]

During the creation process an obvious question appeared: "What's it like to play as a Vampire?" To answer this we played many games with somewhat similar gameplay we wanted to deliver in Beast Hour. First of all, let's mention Nosgoth. Our team loves this title and thanks to a still very active and supportive community on [url=https://discord.gg/HYWXTZDN4R]Discord[/url] we managed to get a lot of useful info about the game mechanics and its heroes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/083bf5a350cb054bcd4a765db277bc9219d17b25.jpg[/img]

Sentinel from Nosgoth became a reference character for a number of Vampire abilities in Beast Hour. For example, we implemented our variation of Wing Flap skill. In Beast Hour it comes in handy considering we've got a very vertical oriented gameplay where you can throw enemies off the rooftops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/755feb9ce2832c0e8f26ab625aff0d97bbb95cc0.gif[/img]

Also, Takeoff ability from Nosgoth seemed fitting to Beast Hour gameplay. This skill allows you to very rapidly gain altitude from any open area on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/0567e949b803e7269b50f91fbc91b28189a66571.gif[/img]

Sentinel's flight had almost no limits – you could fly all over the map as you please, but for Beast Hour we decided that it would be a wrong decision to copy that. We call our game "parkour horror" for a reason – all Beasts should also explore the streets, use walls and look for prey in underground pathways. That's why we chose to use gliding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/f9068ab0f959f3a303b80b68e972b1bce60c6598.jpg[/img]

For this mechanic we took inspiration from Batman Arkham Knight. In this game you could glide and do a cool move called Dive Bomb. It's a special attack you can make while gliding – your character starts to fall down to a point on the ground you picked and deals damage to enemies around the landing spot. By the way, if you haven't yet played this phenomenal game by Rocksteady Studios – go ahead and do it asap!

[b]Is the Vampire ready?[/b]

No. We want to stress once again that this Beast is not yet ready. Or, as we call it, ready in "grey form".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/1adc47ba019a3485c7f94a9078ad6632a1a2ee58.gif[/img]

That's how we make characters for Beast Hour: it starts with a concept art. Then we create a draft 3D-model in A-pose and see how it looks like in the engine (we use Unity). After some adjustments implemented (to make sure the size and body proportions of the character work fine in an actual game environment) the draft model is used to create rigs and animations. At this point we also make VFX. Once satisfied with the results – we build a high poly model, create and add textures, fix bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/0cd8dbaa68af50bb87dcfe8dc3d3dd00655a4b1f.gif[/img]

Right now we are in the very final phase. Thus, to give you the Vampire to play with, we first need to finish its visuals and resolve bugs. The thing is that the Vampire has three types of movement – running, parkouring and flying. The transition mechanics between these states are the most challenging to fix, yet we've almost finished that process!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/3572ffc02e841b7618465d99f85895d18446d924.gif[/img]

[b]Do Vampires have any lore?[/b]

For every character, faction and location in the game we come up with lore. It's much easier to create visuals and build a gameplay style if you are aware of the hero's background. Now we are ready to share the most vital facts about these creatures, but be ready to find out much more in the game itself!

So, Vampires in the Beast Hour universe are united under the Eternal Ones clan banner. They got their name due to the almost eternal lifespan every Vampire is blessed with. Some of the clan members remember how the world looked like more than 3,000 years ago!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/14bcfb9af8f255803b13756cd3af91b4c5912982.gif[/img]

Eternal Ones have a single leader and are divided into two generations:

1) Aztli Talla ("Blood Mistress") – the Empress of the fallen empire and the head of the Vampires. She possesses an unprecedented power when in her Beast form, but she also can turn into a human.

2) The First Generation – the higher nobility and the circle of Aztli Talla's closest servants. As a result of their long hibernation they have lost the ability to return to human form. Their power is inferior to Blood Mistress.

3) The Second Generation – the youngest (not older than 550 years) and the most numerous generation. They still can turn into humans, but their power is significantly inferior as compared to the First Generation.

Eternal Ones believe that the end of the world – Beast Hour – shall soon come. In their interpretation of the prophecy the Blood God will return and plunge the whole world into darkness, thus making Vampires no longer afraid of the sunlight. In this new age the Eternal Hunt shall start – an endless battle between Werewolves, Vampires and other clans will rage across the continents. Only the strongest and most worthy will prevail in this battle to rule over the new eternity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/5e1a91f16ccab8e85b42903e6373490a0da758c8.gif[/img]

[b]To sum it up[/b]

Our whole team behind Beast Hour development can't wait for you to get your hands on the Vampire! If you have any questions – go ahead and ask, we'll do our best to answer. Have no doubt – we're making Beast Hour for you!

Please, make sure to check out our livestreams we regularly have at our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH8SHBl_9bXEuNOr2ddveMQ]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/beasthourgame]Twitch [/url]channels for almost an entire year by now. The next stream will take place in the middle of November, and the latest one you can found on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=43kosM_wvuA&t=1248s]Youtube[/url].

Wishlist Beast Hour on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563250/Beast_Hour/]Steam[/url], follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/BeastHour]social media[/url] channels and support on [url=https://www.patreon.com/beasthour]Patreon[/url] – it does help our small indie team to bring Beast Hour to a next level!

By the way, Beast Hour needs your help to prepare German, Italian, Portuguese and Korean translations! And if you know French, Spanish, Polish, Chinese, Arabic or Japanese – we have a bunch of texts awaiting your proofreading! You can contact us via email: info@beasthour.com 

And if you want to take a deep dive in development or discuss other forms of cooperation, use this: bizdev@beasthour.com

notes.title: Beast Hour. №14. September 2022

Raiders & Beasts!

September has started and ended so swiftly, we can't believe it! We've been so busy making new content for the future Alpha test! Map changes, new features, quality of life improvements – all of it is coming soon! Let us show you what we’ve got in stock for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/6f38825a9ce0912e1795035b0da50d31d216b5d2.jpg[/img]

[b]Map visuals[/b]

First off, the map of the game. Our artists, 3D-modelers and level designers have been very busy adding variety to the haunted city. Underground pathways and landmarks have been added, along with improvements in the natural environment – and that's just the beginning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/5119519c85472893a4e8af73b5af2bcc3dbe06a7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/4af63fe3b093234df8b5dc3b620da72fabee207a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/35c01d940ae4e14de108b0507a559c7b4e7ef58e.jpg[/img]

[b]Nicknames[/b]

The gameplay feature you’ve been asking us a lot for is the addition of nicknames. Now it’s possible to assign your in-game nickname, so the next time you fight or kill someone, they will know your name (or vice versa)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/f7a3709c19c2f2480787fd7b76c713751506fcf7.jpg[/img]

[b]No more freezes[/b]

As we’ve explained in one of our previous newsletters, the freezes that took place at the start of every match were caused by a technical necessity. Now we’ve fixed the issue, so you can enjoy the game without freezes – and with new hint screens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/46c805c2f6d75b7277759717b211368a85708f3c.jpg[/img]

[b]Zip Lines[/b]

Running away from Werewolves is difficult and we know that perfectly well. The feature currently in development and planned for the next playtest, is Zip Lines. They will help you get down from high rooftops with ease, in order to get some distance between you and a Beast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/e4f1661c7347c7b05905619a5efccd54c1416d07.gif[/img]

Archive footage of the first Zip Line test. As you can see, not all Zelus' inventions work as intended from the start...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/aa739dcdebbfb77c461ee6ad13089fcfb1de1c84.gif[/img]

[b]NEW TEST is coming in the second part of autumn![/b]

We're not ready to give an exact date yet, but rest assured – a new Beast Hour test is just around the corner! It will include features mentioned in this very newsletter, ones we discussed in a previous issue, and a few pleasant surprises! Keep an eye on the news to update Steam game version in advance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/179ed619a8ca225088b6b6e3ec0e522ec0f538a4.jpg[/img]

Raiders & Beasts!

The 3rd Beast Hour open playtest took place at the beginning of August. Now, we're making changes and preparing for the next and the best playtest yet! Let’s have a look together at Beast Hour's development updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/eae0df82627e451a709e3fd894fc45ddc9a9f209.jpg[/img]

[b]Action logs[/b]

Something is constantly happening to you in Beast Hour. To help you keep track of everything, we have added an action log feature. Now, each time you collect Arkana, fight with other players or escape Beasts, there will appear a special notification in the left part of the screen, showing the experience received.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/34ff203aca7d56cab80353cc2b10727d911a596d.jpg[/img]

[b]Less penalty for falling down[/b]

We often hear that new Beast Hour players have difficulties with parkour playing as Raiders. It’s true that our movement system takes some time to get used to. There can be a short superhero-style stun upon landing if you fall from a great height. Now, it takes much more height for the stun to occur.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/8ff02753ece0f1bfc1bf744e381196c521695eec.gif[/img]

[b]Sound settings[/b]

Ever since the first public playtest you asked us to add sound settings. This request was especially important for streamers and bloggers. We are glad to tell you that this feature has finally been added! Feel free to tweak different aspects of the sound settings to your liking.

notes.title: Beast Hour. №12. July 2022
notes.notes:
Raiders & Beasts!

The second test of Beast Hour is over. We’ve received A LOT of feedback – thank you for participating and telling us your ideas. New tests are coming, so stay tuned and don't miss out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/78de5470d3fc44cac886c29a7f2c11ef0c670551.jpg[/img]

During these amazing playtests and after them you've been asking about many things. We try to answer everyone on Discord, Twitter, Reddit, via DMs, etc. as new questions keep coming all the time. This particular newsletter highlights the most popular topics and shares some plans for the future.

[b]Server-connection issues[/b]

When the servers go live for the first time, something always goes wrong. And it did. The most noticeable problem was waiting for the connection to a match. Some people spent up to 30 minutes looking for a match. That was really unfortunate.

BUT! The combination of the dev team work & cool advice of server engineers from our community worked like magic! During the second test the situation greatly improved, and the average wait time was no longer than about 3 minutes. We keep on making servers better, as there is always room for improvement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/db43b634240beb99f3676d792025fa1f0725e644.gif[/img]

[b]3 hours limitation[/b]

Both of the tests were limited in terms of time available to play. That was done due to the following reasons:

1) Beast Hour is still in development and our audience is still growing (you are really very kind and supportive, by the way!) So, to be sure that there are enough players to play with, we set this exact day and time window to bring everybody together.

2) As the server infrastructure is currently working in a test mode, it can't be running 24/7. It’s simply not possible at this stage of development, unfortunately.

We totally understand that these playtest time windows cannot be perfect for everyone. Especially for people in Asia and Australia. The choice of the time was based on Steam data – usually during these hours players play action PvP games like Beast Hour. So, this way most part of our community can get their hands on the game.

If you want to make tests last longer and more, visit our [url=https://www.patreon.com/beasthour]Patreon[/url] page – every donation matters!

Or do the most important thing: come and participate in future tests, tell your friends about Beast Hour, follow us on social media & share our posts! Remember – multiplayer game is its community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/23f70e6378d756107e12e97fde3b81eb8da60408.jpg[/img]

[b]Beasts are too strong[/b]

Beast Hour is a game about intense and dynamic parkour chases between Raiders and Beasts. From the very beginning of development we wanted players to feel that monsters are hunters and human characters are prey. That’s why, for example, Werewolves deal much more damage. It should be an especially difficult challenge if a Raider decides to fight a Beast rather than run away.

But it’s important to mention that there are only 3 Beasts and 5 Raiders in every single match. It’s a well-considered decision made to balance the game. Yet it’s not enough. Werewolves are, of course, stronger but Raiders are more nimble in the matter of movement, so use it! Parkour and never ever try to run in a straight line!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/581f50c63a39a2a49702582624d0a271ff285f7a.gif[/img]

[b]Game freezes[/b]

We have a small yet annoying issue at the very beginning of the match. The thing is that for a few seconds there are no game objects to interact with, and once they appear on the map, the game freezes not for long no matter how good your PC is. Truth be told, many multiplayer games face the same problem, but they manage to find a way to conceal it one way or another.

In our case the plan is to add corresponding tutorial screens, which will be shown to every player, according to a character he/she has chosen. And only after that the player gets the control over the character and the match starts. By doing so, on the one hand, new players are introduced to the rules of the game no matter what, and, on the other hand, this unpleasant yet necessary situation is hidden.

By the way, we have a [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQmBZ0P_Og9seydf29g-bmjZRE7kolblv]video tutorial[/url]! Please, watch it before your next test!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2bb287617429f53cf226dd3c641059900f4317d2.jpg[/img]

[b]In addition[/b]

Keep asking questions and check our future newsletters for answers!

We stream Beast Hour and answer your questions every month – you can watch the latest [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CDIWcPF5iVg]video[/url] on our YouTube channel. Join the next stream in the middle of August!

[b]Alpha-tests[/b]

Important date in Beast Hour history: 19th of June, 2022. This day we had our first public test and it lasted for three hours straight. Our goals for the test were:

1) Get your feedback on the gameplay (btw, you can leave it [url=https://forms.gle/krY6uGMySHaiPbDM8]here[/url] – it’d help us tremendously)

Right now we are preparing the next version of the game which can take some time as we do want to make the game better and not just release the same build. The exact date of the next test will be announced later – stay tuned and join our [url=http://discord.gg/5KFaakTP24]Discord[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/63a9b3c0a4167ca5f58b52c70280394b1eceb661.gif[/img]

[b]Things we’re working on[/b]

We decided to focus on a few main issues first:

1) Udoku felt underpowered compared to Zelus.
2) It was difficult to get connected to a match.
3) Raiders need more ways to escape Beasts.
4) Sound options should be added.

Closer to the start of the next test we’ll be able to tell you more about the upcoming changes in detail.

- When you play as Raider – run away from Beasts, but not in a straight line: use parkour to get higher and always change directions to keep some distance between you and Beast.

- When you play as Beast – capture Altars (=parts of the map) to use Howl and track down Raiders with ease.
- As a Beast your HP gets automatically restored by simply staying out of a fight for some time. Also destroying Arkana speeds up the regeneration and empowers your next attacks.
- You can read gameplay tips and descriptions of abilities pressing F1 and F2 during the match.

Beast Hour is a game about the freedom of movement – you can explore every corner of the map no matter how high above or low underground this place is. [b]MAP[/b]

The previously empty temple and desolate catacombs beneath the city, as well as many other places around it, have started to change. The decoration is far from being finished, but it’s clear that Beast Hour is becoming better each day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/861ce69d2020724fcb015b15c326dc0b3a365af1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/3ff21901a5f952a88e30852ee37c61ac26942515.jpg[/img]

[b]RIFT[/b]

Rifts are one of the sources to get Arkana (=EXP). Playing as Raider, you will have to find them, then capture and hold for some time. While you possess a Rift, you’ll get Arkana and healing every second. As the opened Rift creates a huge beam of light into the sky, other players will intervene: Raiders will try to take the Rift away from you, and Beasts will do their best to shut it down. But no Rift is infinite – once the Arkana deposits have been pumped out, there will appear a huge Drop of Arkana, which you will have to pick up manually.

Recently, we started adding new visuals and animations for Rifts capturing. It’s still a work-in-progress, but we are so excited with what has been done so far that we decided to give you a sneak peek.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/da5f3cb2b8f5c9e04b879d0b180992b7b0f71a29.gif[/img]

Although this monster won't be available at Alpha, let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/c05dbc29e575a4731c5b5358966dd487cc8f6146.jpg[/img]

[b]ROPE[/b]

Rope is one of our escape-mechanics we plan to add during the Alpha-testing. 

Raiders can use ropes to get on the roof of the building very quickly – it especially comes in handy when you try to get away from Beasts or want to collect that shiny Arkana way up above you.

You can find out more about another escape-mechanic, “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250?emclan=103582791469900204&emgid=3105799226887462320]cracked wall[/url]”, in our previous newsletter.

Beast Hour is approaching! Wishlist the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563250/Beast_Hour/]Steam[/url] and sign up for [url=https://mailchi.mp/11aebf4bafa7/join-beast-hour-eng]Alpha-testing[/url]!

[b]SPIDERS DISTRICT[/b]

The map is becoming better and better! This time the center of our attention was the so-called “Spider district” (not the final name).

I think you can safely assume that there are A LOT of spiders in there. But worry not – most of them are dead. What remains are cocoons, webs and bodies of both humans and spiders scattered all around the streets. 

We’ve hidden many secrets for the players to uncover there. Do you have the courage to step in and find them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/aedde350c7c027e9822fa382589ea23bd5d16918.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/dd0df7a87dc82eed59b92247ff2dea106ddc2b66.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/9c4877701e60928e160194f2f1f698f6d8b77021.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/f9f4d1628894e6b9cdab3a3f47f520169b85d687.jpg[/img]

[b]FUNNY BUG[/b]

Some say bugs can’t be fun – we disagree! 

We managed to prove that constantly exploding vault-objects give a good laugh. They drop your FPS but, hey, you cannot get all at the same time:)

Did you encounter any funny bugs playing games recently?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/54c920eee3bab04f8eecaf201ec6e04c1b078f7b.gif[/img]

[b]CRYSTALS[/b]

Crystals can be found almost anywhere on the map. During the game you are to locate and blow them up to then collect pieces of Arkana that burst out of the crystals. Follow the trails from the blast site to find that precious Arkana and become stronger!

It’s our latest but not the first iteration of this mechanic. For example, initially, you would have to activate the crystal and wait for about 30 seconds to collect the reward. Honestly, it was boring. We realized that pretty quickly and that’s why we remade the whole gameplay cycle. 

Now we decided to improve the visuals of these crystals. Here’s the current version and a few new variations. Which one do you like the most?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/bbe099715269f4f6a5872a0bc8ecaeca96d6bcbd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/636f064774df2c2bdf9a1e6a40e1a37786e9d993.jpg[/img]

[b]DEAD BY DAYLIGHT MEETS BEAST HOUR[/b]

As developers of the asymmetric PvP-horror game, we are big fans of Dead by Daylight! 

Last month we compared chasing in DbD with the one in Beast Hour. We shared the results with [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/deadbydaylight/comments/rr6rkq/got_so_inspired_by_dbd_that_created_a_whole_new/]r/deadbydaylight[/url] community and they were very excited to try out our game:)

This time we imagined what if Zelus came into The Fog and met The Trapper. Who do you think will be prey in such a case?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/32fc9637c2eceaa85fc70c11f866bf0d84eccad3.jpg[/img]

[b]ESCAPE-MECHANIC[/b]

Parkour is great! It’s the basis of our game. But even the best traceurs sometimes can’t do much against the tremendous might that Beasts possess. Because of that we’ve prepared something cool for you – new ways of escaping monsters. We call them – escape-mechanics.

The first one we’ve been playing with lately is a cracked wall. Raiders can roll right beneath it to keep Beast busy destroying the obstacle or finding a way around. It gives the pursued player a few extra seconds to hide and escape.

Have you seen such or similar mechanic in other games and how do you like it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/71def4ff7d5aff48d96ae906d38513f74d1f917c.gif[/img]

[b]ON TOP OF THAT[/b]

We keep on working on servers and matchmaking to start Alpha-testing we all have been waiting for. You can read more about our preparations in our previous month’s summary [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250?emclan=103582791469900204&emgid=4515423468949419244]here[/url].

notes.title: Beast Hour. №6. January 2022
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We are developers of Beast Hour – asymmetric PvP-horror with parkour & monsters! 

The game is being made primarily for PC players of horror, asymmetric and online games. Our indie team has made a long way and now Beast Hour is in the pre-Alpha stage. Here’s where you can sign up for [url=https://mailchi.mp/11aebf4bafa7/join-beast-hour-eng]Alpha-testing[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/60877c7182f3ce8e1693ceba00cc2eeda3f11166.jpg[/img]

We love talking with our players! That's why we want to tell you more about the game’s development, share details about the behind-the-scenes content and, in general, keep you in touch with everything interesting happening with Beast Hour. The beginning of a new year is thematically the best time to start, isn’t it?:)

[b]USER INTERFACE (UI)[/b]

It’d be fair to say that Beast Hour didn’t have a proper UI at all. I mean, user interface was technically in place but the thing is – it was a temporary solution that wasn’t particularly good-looking and user-friendly.

Last year we started prototyping a new UI almost from scratch. This month the first new version has seen the light of day and it has been put to the test.

Just compare how user interface looked like back then and now:

[i]Main menu:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/880ee9291c78d5c6987cce1d8c0fed018562a913.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/286059076754d949a77aecf4d1b7c439c269a439.jpg[/img]

[i]During the gameplay:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2f631cecdf9fef8e617ef5378739b1768d322d7b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/e4fcad3b1f42c526d4b3e86e408a1da1f77292f6.jpg[/img]

I want to make it 100% clear – it’s NOT A FINAL VERSION. On the one hand, we already have the plans for UI improvements and, on the other hand, what is more important, there will be Beast Hour Alpha testers’ feedback.

[b]LOCATIONS[/b]

The center of attention this time has become the “green district” where mushrooms have grown and many new mini-locations appeared, such as a windmill, graveyard and other fascinating places!

[i]Underground location of the green district. December of 2021 and January of 2022:[/i]

I remember how someone asked us: what was the funniest bug you ever had in Beast Hour. Of course, the problem has already been fixed by now but it was good fun playing with it:)

[b]MOST SUCCESSFUL POST[/b]

We got into the habit of posting a new piece of content on our social media channels at least once a day. It doesn’t matter if it’s a weekend or a holiday even. It’s not easy to work at such a pace but we believe that this is the way.

The most chunk of attention, likes and retweets we got under this post on [url=https://twitter.com/BeastHourGame/status/1484194013343363073]Twitter[/url]. This gif shows how Beast Hour looked like a bit more than a year ago from now.

[b]STEAM-PAGE UPDATE[/b]

Steam-page is like the face of the project. For more than half a year we didn’t change its content at all. At the end of December it became clear that it’s the wrong approach. Many screenshots got outdated and the description was too cumbersome. It was time to change!

The logline of the project got remade with the strong emphasis put on the asymmetrical nature of Beast Hour. We also tried to describe our key features in a better way. Every new screenshot now ought to have an interesting narrative conveying through it. 

Just have a look yourself!

Ever since the launch of Beast Hour Patreon-page we held a closed Q&A-stream every month for our supporters. Now it’s open to everyone!

[previewyoutube=w4AmiEaAPf4;full][/previewyoutube]
We did have some sound issues but hopefully they will get resolved within a few months:)

[b]START OF ALPHA-TESTING[/b]

Right now all of our programmers are busy preparing servers for the launch of Alpha. Gameplay-wise the game is mostly ready, but the process of connecting to a game server is not an easy thing to do:

One of the developers creates a room thereby becoming a server.
Then he or she sends other players his or her IP address.
They put this IP address into a special line.
Players connect to the server and they can play.
After the end of the match players have to redo everything again.

Once the programmers have finished their work, the connection becomes much easier:

You press “Play”.
Then you connect to an automatically created server.
Profit!

We do our best to hasten the day this matter is settled to start Alpha-testing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/cac37cb81e406118ee748d0092fd41de4f52d1a3.jpg[/img]

But if you are eager to try the game out right now, we have a solution for you – join us on [url=http://patreon.com/beasthour]Patreon[/url]! You’ll also be first to receive our lore materials about the game, you’ll get access to a closed chat and special roles on [url=http://discord.gg/5KFaakTP24]Discord[/url] and your name will be in the credits. Contact us via email if you want to participate in the development or feel like discussing other forms of cooperation – [url=mailto:bizdev@beasthour.com]bizdev@beasthour.com[/url].

notes.title: Beast Hour. №4. Making of the PvP-parkour from werewolves🐺
notes.notes:
Hi! Today we want to tell you about Beast Hour development story. The idea of our own game came to us back in 2017 and the initial concept was: ninjas vs werewolves. The main references were: parkour chases gameplay from Prince of Persia: Warrior Within, the aesthetics of Order 1886, and also the asymmetric elements from Nosgoth and Dead by Daylight. Soon we made the first prototype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/10f7fcee3238512b0828750b58b4ffb98bccbb18.gif[/img]
[i]One of the first animations, 2017. Do you also enjoy the wallrun animation? :)
[/i]
At that time Raiders used parkour to gather special spheres and bring them to Altars to escape. Beasts (two random players) hunted down Raiders in order to turn them into the same monsters. If you escape the map as Raider – you win. If at some point you got turned into Beast – you had to kill as many Raiders as possible. 
The team was focused on the controls system and parkour, camera work, and the creation of a location for vertical gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/65afc17033cc70fe27eb49e80ee4bf85ce34d4ca.gif[/img]
[i]First half of 2018[/i]

The hardest part was parkour. When we started there were no PvP third-person games focusing on parkour chases to get direct inspiration from. That was a tricky part but also a cool one: we knew we would be first to make something like this, but it required much effort and time. In 2018 some of our team members started to work on the game full-time. Comprehensive work began.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2e2cf4352450d1c2b77ecefc3f9d8e41549ed8ed.gif[/img]
[i]Second half of 2018[/i]

“Great games are played, not made” – if we had known this Todd Howard’s quote back then, we would have made it our motto. Why? – playtests among the team with frequent invitations of friends and relatives are permanent practice ever since the beginning of the development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/e284010802c5ceb944e5349a2a66d4ba97284073.gif[/img]
[i]2019 version[/i]

At that time a lot of people in the team thought that the release was within our grasp. It was just a question of fixing the bugs, polishing the interface, and drawing the attention of the bloggers and we could release. The turning point was between 2019 and 2020. Our programmer paid the team’s attention that we were not developing the rules and it was just boring to play. It was a shock for us, but after a while we all agreed and decided that we needed to change the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/e19c507771021fb61bf38ddd31e65eaf7a377584.gif[/img]
[i]2020 version[/i]

The map, which was completely ready, and a large part of the match rules were remade from scratch. Now a player had to choose the character at the beginning of the match and could not change it during the game. We experimented with team modes but decided that it was not the gameplay for us and chose ‘no allies’ solution. We went through not less than four new maps playtesting just grey-box. We ran dozens of playtests and finally, by the end of 2020, we found the necessary formula.

[i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/aad5cc339c4ec7d9e9bf0f0ee4d23b52877d34af.gif[/img]
2021 version[/i]

Now we are working on Alpha-testing and we put all our effort to launch it as soon as possible. For the past year, our team has doubled!
